summary: Amazon invests $50B in OpenAI's $110B round at $730B pre-money: $15B up front and $35B once conditions were met, all paid by late July 2026.
notes: Amazon's release and its 10-Q confirm the $35B was conditional. The 10-Q shows $15.0B paid in Q1 2026, $13.7B in Q2 and the remaining $21.3B after June 30, 2026.
